rule.support: all unique fixed TSDF vertices visible in this frame and inside the complete mask
rule.crop_contact_policy: exclude any mask touching an artificial source-crop edge before grouping; original image borders alone are allowed
rule.crop_filter_applies_to: all source-eligible masks including semantic SAM; no CropFormer fallback for window/cabinet
rule.exact_duplicate_key: frame + identical full-image binary mask; retain every original occurrence
rule.grouping: descending TSDF support count; compare remaining masks only to the fixed primary seed; no transitive expansion
rule.source_policy: window/cabinet SAM-only; any prior semantic CropFormer replacement is global across all ROI occurrences
rule.policy_order: SAM-only source eligibility, artificial crop filter, area and edge morphology filter, ordinary 3D IoU grouping, maximum TSDF support count
rule.primary_seed: largest unique TSDF support count among source-eligible masks
rule.tie_break: ascending frame, model index, full-mask digest; no area ranking
rule.noise_policy: whole-mask exclusion; no pixel erosion; screen all previous crop-safe eligible masks including SAM

filter_config.decision_rule: suggest_exclude when >=90% of unchanged mask pixels have argmax in excluded classes AND softmax max >=0.7; retain when >=90% are confident nonexcluded; otherwise review and operationally retain
filter_config.preprocess: official SegformerImageProcessor config; whole RGB frame resized to 640x640; no crop
filter_config.postprocess: bilinear resize float32 logits to original H,W, align_corners=False, then softmax/argmax; direct model id2label with no label offset
filter_config.sensitivity_policy: descriptive only; original 0.7/0.9 decisions frozen before comparison

scope: Suggested whole-mask exclusions; uncertain retained; no deduplication or E1 run
